title: Microscope QC
description: Microscope quality control with MetroloJ_QC's definitions: lateral and axial FWHM of sub-resolution beads against the theoretical resolution, and field-illumination uniformity and centring.

run-qc.title: Run quality control
run-qc.description: PSF from beads: detect beads in one z-stack, fit Gaussian x, y and z profiles and summarise FWHM against theory. Field illumination: uniformity, field uniformity and centering accuracy of one image of a uniform slide.

image.description: One single-channel TIFF: a bead z-stack (one plane per page) or one field image

analysis.description: psf for a bead z-stack, field for a field-illumination image; defaults to psf for a stack and field for one plane

microscope.description: Microscope type, which sets the theoretical resolution formula

na.description: Objective numerical aperture; read from OME-XML LensNA when recorded

refractiveIndex.description: Immersion refractive index; read from OME-XML when recorded

emission.description: Emission wavelength in nm (widefield and spinning disk)

excitation.description: Excitation wavelength in nm (confocal and multiphoton)

pixelX.description: Pixel width in µm; read from the TIFF when recorded

pixelY.description: Pixel height in µm; read from the TIFF when recorded

zStep.description: z step in µm; read from the TIFF when recorded

boxRadius.description: Bead box half-width in µm; default four theoretical lateral FWHMs

prominence.description: Bead prominence in grey levels; default 10 background SDs of the maximum projection

minR2.description: Minimum adjusted R² of all three fits for a bead to enter the summary

excludeSaturated.description: Reject beads with a saturated voxel in their box

step.description: Iso-intensity zone step in percent (field illumination)

blur.description: Blur the field image with ImageJ's Gaussian, σ = 2 px, before measuring

referenceZone.description: Centre on the top iso-intensity zone's centroid rather than the brightest pixel
